name: Stormbringer: Child of the Storm and Storm Rider reduce cooldowns natively (#777, #2790)
contract: #777 and #2790 report 'Spell Script / Aura Handler Not Implemented' for two passives that are plain Spell.dbc SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN modifiers under Stormbringer's own SpellFamilyName 22, matched by SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod/IsAffected with no per-family override anywhere in SpellInfo.cpp, and consumed generically by Player::GetSpellRecoveryTime. #777: Child of the Storm (804038) is aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), EffectBasePoints -21 + 1 = -20%, EffectSpellClassMask[2] = 0xC00000 = bit22|bit23, matching Cloudburst 801838's SpellFamilyFlags[2] = 0x800000 (bit23) and Windsurf 500042's SpellFamilyFlags[2] = 0x400000 (bit22). #2790: Storm Rider (705677) is aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, same MiscValue 11, EffectBasePoints -5001 + 1 = -5000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask[1] = 0x800 matching Gale Guard 500923/504872's SpellFamilyFlags[1] = 0x800, and EffectSpellClassMask[2] = 0x800000 matching Cloudburst's own bit23 again. Neither target spell sets SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS (0x20000000); Gale Guard rank 2's unrelated AttributesEx3 bit (0x40000000) does not block the modifier. Zero hits for either spell ID in the module/scripts/pending SQL, matching each issue's own grep claim, is expected: both are stock generic-pipeline percent/flat cooldown mods that need no module code. Values are the server's own Player::ApplySpellMod, measured before and after learning on the same actor.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Learn Cloudburst so it exists in the spellbook
Learn Windsurf so it exists in the spellbook

BASELINE: Cloudburst's cooldown modifier is 0 without Child of the Storm or Storm Rider
BASELINE: Windsurf's cooldown modifier is 0 without Child of the Storm
BASELINE: Gale Guard's cooldown modifier is 0 without Storm Rider
DISCRIMINATING: Child of the Storm cuts Cloudburst's cooldown by 20% (via classmask bit23)
DISCRIMINATING: Child of the Storm cuts Windsurf's cooldown by 20% (via classmask bit22)
Child of the Storm's mask does not touch Gale Guard (control)
DISCRIMINATING: Storm Rider cuts Gale Guard's cooldown by a flat 5000 ms (via classmask bit11)
